title: UTCS Transaction Context
description: The canonical input to all UTCS tax determination operations. Describes the commerce transaction for which tax compliance is being requested. Supports flexible ingestion through Input Profiles.

profile.description: Input profile being used. If omitted, 'utcs-standard' is assumed.

document_type.description: Transaction type. Providers MUST reject unrecognized values with UTCS-3002.

document_code.description: The caller's key for this transaction when the caller sends one. Optional. A caller SHOULD send it when commit is true: UTCS-6001 rejects a repeated commit of that code, and without it a retry is a new document. When the caller omits it, the provider MAY generate a document_code. The Tax Result always returns one: the caller's value if sent, otherwise the generated value. Used for idempotency and reconciliation.

company_code.description: Identifier of the selling entity (company) the transaction belongs to. Routes the transaction to the correct registered entity within the provider account, which determines nexus, registration, and where the tax is reported.

transaction_date.description: ISO 8601 datetime of the transaction. Determines applicable rates and rules. Dates outside the provider's supported range are rejected with UTCS-4004.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this transaction.

commit.description: true = the transaction is committed (final). false = estimate only. The provider records committed transactions for its own downstream reporting and filing; uncommitted calculations can be recalculated freely.

entity_type.description: Relationship type of the transaction parties. Providers MUST reject unrecognized values with UTCS-3002.

customer.description: Customer details including identifiers and exemption credentials.

customer_code.description: Unique customer identifier in the caller's system.

exemption_certificate_id.description: Reference to an exemption certificate on file with the provider. The provider MUST apply it or reject the request with UTCS-5001, UTCS-5002, UTCS-5003, or UTCS-5004. It MUST NOT be ignored. A prior successful exemption validation does not apply it.

entity_use_code.description: Entity/use-based exemption reason asserting the buyer is exempt by status or intended use (e.g., government, charitable, resale), independent of a certificate on file. Applies to the whole transaction unless a line overrides it. Uses the same controlled vocabulary as the result exemption_reason. A certificate, when present, is supplied via exemption_certificate_id.

addresses.description: Transaction addresses. ship_from and ship_to are REQUIRED, OR single_location for point-of-sale. Providers MUST reject missing required addresses with UTCS-3001.

ship_from.description: Origin address. REQUIRED unless single_location is provided.

ship_to.description: Destination address. REQUIRED unless single_location is provided.

single_location.description: For point-of-sale transactions where origin and destination are the same location.

point_of_order_acceptance.description: Where the order was accepted. Relevant for US tangible personal property sourcing.

point_of_order_origin.description: Where the order originated. Relevant for US tangible personal property sourcing.

bill_to.description: Customer's billing address. Sourcing rules that look at bill-to use this address, including California SB 122 (effective 1 January 2027), which sources SaaS and prewritten software by billing address first. bill_to does not satisfy ship_to. A caller that has only a billing address sends that same address as both bill_to and ship_to. The provider does not copy bill_to into ship_to.

lines.description: Line items. MUST contain at least one item. Empty arrays are rejected with UTCS-3001.

discount.description: Transaction-level discount amount as a decimal string. Allocated across lines flagged discounted. Affects taxability in jurisdictions that tax discounted vs. original prices differently.

marketplace.description: Marketplace facilitator context. Present when a marketplace facilitator is involved and may be the party liable to collect and remit tax. Determines which party the provider treats as responsible for the tax.

facilitated.description: true if a marketplace facilitator is involved in this transaction.

liable_party.description: Party responsible for collecting and remitting the tax.

facilitator_id.description: Identifier of the marketplace facilitator (e.g., its tax registration or platform identifier).

reference_code.description: Optional reference to a related document or external system. When document_type is return and this is the original transaction's document_code, the provider MUST reverse the original tax for the returned portion and MUST NOT recalculate it at current rates. When that document cannot be found, the provider returns UTCS-6002. On any other document type this is an audit cross-reference and does not change the calculation.

purchase_order_number.description: Buyer's purchase order number. Optional. Carried for audit; does not affect tax determination.

exchange_rate.description: Currency exchange rate from currency_code to reporting currency. REQUIRED when invoicing currency differs from the jurisdiction's reporting currency. Defaults to 1.0.

exchange_rate_currency_code.description: ISO 4217 three-character reporting currency code. REQUIRED when exchange_rate is provided.

tax_override.description: Override tax calculation behavior for returns, imported amounts, and accrual scenarios.

value.description: Override value. For tax_date: ISO 8601 date. For tax_amount: decimal string. For exemption: exemption reason code.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the override. Required for audit trail.

parameters.description: Key-value pairs for protocol-specific or provider-specific metadata.
